page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.26xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 104 dedicated physical cores and 104 vCPUs, maintaining a strict one-to-one mapping of one thread per core. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 1.85 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for data persistence. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps and does not include any GPU accelerators. The primary hardware tradeoff lies in its low memory-to-CPU ratio, which prioritizes raw integer and floating-point execution capacity over memory-intensive operations.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation provides predictable compute performance without the resource contention typical of hyperthreaded environments. This resource profile is designed for compute-bound workloads that require high parallel processing capabilities but have modest memory footprints. Suitable applications include high-performance computing, batch processing, scientific modeling, and highly parallelized CPU-bound simulation tasks.
